mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_account_inventory_setting(account_id,inventory_start_date,user_id) VALUES(#{account_id},#{inventory_start_date,jdbcType=DATE},#{user_id}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE inventory_start_date=VALUES(inventory_start_date),user_id=VALUES(user_id)
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_goods_receipt SET status=CASE WHEN #{inventory_start_date,jdbcType=DATE} IS NULL OR receipt_date<#{inventory_start_date,jdbcType=DATE} THEN 'HISTORY' ELSE 'UNMATCHED' END WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND purchase_order_id IS NULL AND status IN ('HISTORY','UNMATCHED')
mapper.select: SELECT ss.supplier_account_site_id,ss.supplier_id,ss.external_site_code,ss.external_site_name,s.supplier_code,s.supplier_name FROM tb_supplier_account_site ss JOIN tb_supplier s ON s.supplier_id=ss.supplier_id WHERE ss.account_id=#{account_id} AND ss.active_yn='Y' AND s.supplier_code IN ('WELSTORY','OURHOME') AND s.supplier_code=#{supplier_code} ORDER BY s.supplier_code,ss.external_site_code
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_account_purchase_order WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND supplier_id=#{supplier_id} AND client_ord=#{client_ord}

SELECT supplier_product_id,product_name,order_unit,base_qty,base_unit,alt_base_qty,alt_base_unit FROM tb_supplier_ingredient_product WHERE supplier_id=#{supplier_id} AND supplier_item_code=#{supplier_item_code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_goods_receipt (goods_receipt_id,account_id,supplier_id,supplier_account_site_id,purchase_order_id,provider_receipt_key,receipt_date, status,reconciliation_status,provider_attributes) VALUES(#{goods_receipt_id},#{account_id},#{supplier_id},#{supplier_account_site_id},NULL,#{provider_receipt_key},#{receipt_date}, #{status},'UNMATCHED',#{receipt_attributes}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status=IF(status IN ('HISTORY','UNMATCHED'),VALUES(status),status)

INSERT INTO tb_goods_receipt_item (goods_receipt_id,purchase_order_item_id,supplier_product_id,provider_line_key,ordered_qty,received_qty, order_unit,base_received_qty,base_unit,unit_price,supply_amount,vat_amount,total_amount,tax_type,amount_source, traceability_no,traceability_type,lot_no,expiration_date,ingredient_id,reconciliation_status,provider_attributes) VALUES(#{goods_receipt_id},NULL,#{supplier_product_id},#{provider_line_key},#{ordered_qty},#{received_qty}, #{order_unit},#{base_received_qty},#{base_unit},#{unit_price},#{supply_amount},#{vat_amount},#{total_amount}, #{tax_type,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'SUPPLIER', #{traceability_no},#{traceability_type},NULL,#{expiration_date,jdbcType=DATE},NULL,'UNMATCHED',#{provider_attributes}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE tax_type=IF(inventory_movement_id IS NULL,VALUES(tax_type),tax_type), base_received_qty=IF(inventory_movement_id IS NOT NULL,base_received_qty, IF(ingredient_id IS NULL OR received_qty=0,VALUES(base_received_qty),base_received_qty/received_qty*VALUES(received_qty))), base_unit=IF(inventory_movement_id IS NULL AND ingredient_id IS NULL,VALUES(base_unit),base_unit), ordered_qty=IF(inventory_movement_id IS NULL,VALUES(ordered_qty),ordered_qty), received_qty=IF(inventory_movement_id IS NULL,VALUES(received_qty),received_qty), order_unit=IF(inventory_movement_id IS NULL,VALUES(order_unit),order_unit), unit_price=IF(inventory_movement_id IS NULL,VALUES(unit_price),unit_price), supply_amount=IF(inventory_movement_id IS NULL,VALUES(supply_amount),supply_amount), vat_amount=IF(inventory_movement_id IS NULL,VALUES(vat_amount),vat_amount), total_amount=IF(inventory_movement_id IS NULL,VALUES(total_amount),total_amount), traceability_no=IF(inventory_movement_id IS NULL,VALUES(traceability_no),traceability_no), traceability_type=IF(inventory_movement_id IS NULL,VALUES(traceability_type),traceability_type), expiration_date=IF(inventory_movement_id IS NULL,VALUES(expiration_date),expiration_date), provider_attributes=IF(inventory_movement_id IS NULL,VALUES(provider_attributes),provider_attributes)
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_goods_receipt r SET total_supply_amount=(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.supply_amount),0) FROM tb_goods_receipt_item i WHERE i.goods_receipt_id=r.goods_receipt_id), total_vat=(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.vat_amount),0) FROM tb_goods_receipt_item i WHERE i.goods_receipt_id=r.goods_receipt_id), total_amount=(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.total_amount),0) FROM tb_goods_receipt_item i WHERE i.goods_receipt_id=r.goods_receipt_id) WHERE r.goods_receipt_id=#{goods_receipt_id}
mapper.select: SELECT po.purchase_order_id,oi.purchase_order_item_id FROM tb_account_purchase_order po JOIN tb_account_purchase_order_item oi ON oi.purchase_order_id=po.purchase_order_id WHERE po.account_id=#{account_id} AND po.supplier_id=#{supplier_id} AND po.client_ord=#{client_ord} AND (oi.client_ord_item=#{client_ord_item} OR (oi.client_ord_item REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' AND #{client_ord_item} REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST(oi.client_ord_item AS UNSIGNED)=CAST(#{client_ord_item} AS UNSIGNED))) ORDER BY oi.client_ord_item=#{client_ord_item} DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_supplier_bill_line (account_id,supplier_id,supplier_account_site_id,purchase_order_id,purchase_order_item_id,provider_line_key,bill_date, client_ord,client_ord_item,supplier_item_code,billed_qty,unit_price,supply_amount,vat_amount,total_amount,tax_type,provider_attributes) VALUES(#{account_id},#{supplier_id},#{supplier_account_site_id},#{purchase_order_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{purchase_order_item_id,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{provider_line_key},#{bill_date},#{client_ord},#{client_ord_item},#{supplier_item_code},#{billed_qty},#{unit_price}, #{supply_amount},#{vat_amount},#{total_amount},#{tax_type,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{provider_attributes}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE purchase_order_id=VALUES(purchase_order_id),purchase_order_item_id=VALUES(purchase_order_item_id), bill_date=VALUES(bill_date),billed_qty=VALUES(billed_qty),unit_price=VALUES(unit_price),supply_amount=VALUES(supply_amount), vat_amount=VALUES(vat_amount),total_amount=VALUES(total_amount),tax_type=VALUES(tax_type),provider_attributes=VALUES(provider_attributes)
mapper.select: SELECT supplier_product_id,ingredient_id,base_unit,per_unit FROM ( SELECT i.supplier_product_id,i.ingredient_id,i.base_unit,i.base_received_qty/i.received_qty per_unit, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.supplier_product_id ORDER BY r.receipt_date DESC,i.goods_receipt_item_id DESC) rn FROM tb_goods_receipt_item i JOIN tb_goods_receipt r ON r.goods_receipt_id=i.goods_receipt_id WHERE r.account_id=#{account_id} AND i.ingredient_id IS NOT NULL AND i.received_qty>0 AND i.base_received_qty>0 ) k WHERE k.rn=1
SELECT ingredient_id,base_unit,COALESCE(ingredient_name_std,ingredient_name_raw) ingredient_name FROM tb_account_ingredient_master WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND ingredient_id=#{ingredient_id}

SELECT x.*,COALESCE(ai.ingredient_name_std,ai.ingredient_name_raw) ingredient_name,ai.base_unit ingredient_base_unit FROM ( SELECT p.supplier_product_id,s.supplier_code,s.supplier_name,p.supplier_item_code,p.product_name,p.order_unit, p.base_qty product_base_qty,p.base_unit product_base_unit,p.alt_base_qty,p.alt_base_unit,p.active_yn product_active_yn, COUNT(*) line_count,SUM(i.received_qty) total_received_qty,SUM(i.supply_amount) total_supply_amount,SUM(i.total_amount) total_amount, SUM(i.supply_amount)/NULLIF(SUM(i.received_qty),0) avg_unit_price, MIN(CASE WHEN i.received_qty>0 THEN i.supply_amount/i.received_qty END) min_unit_price, MAX(CASE WHEN i.received_qty>0 THEN i.supply_amount/i.received_qty END) max_unit_price, DATE_FORMAT(MIN(r.receipt_date),'%Y-%m-%d') first_receipt_date,DATE_FORMAT(MAX(r.receipt_date),'%Y-%m-%d') last_receipt_date, COUNT(DISTINCT r.receipt_date) receipt_day_count, SUM(CASE WHEN i.ingredient_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) unlinked_line_count, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT i.ingredient_id ORDER BY i.ingredient_id) ingredient_ids, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT i.ingredient_id)=1 THEN MAX(i.ingredient_id) END ingredient_id FROM tb_goods_receipt_item i JOIN tb_goods_receipt r ON r.goods_receipt_id=i.goods_receipt_id JOIN tb_supplier s ON s.supplier_id=r.supplier_id JOIN tb_supplier_ingredient_product p ON p.supplier_product_id=i.supplier_product_id WHERE r.account_id=#{account_id} GROUP BY p.supplier_product_id,s.supplier_code,s.supplier_name ) x LEFT JOIN tb_account_ingredient_master ai ON ai.account_id=#{account_id} AND ai.ingredient_id=x.ingredient_id WHERE x.unlinked_line_count>0 ORDER BY x.total_supply_amount DESC,x.supplier_product_id

SELECT i.ingredient_id,MAX(COALESCE(ai.ingredient_name_std,ai.ingredient_name_raw)) ingredient_name,i.base_unit, COUNT(*) line_count,COUNT(DISTINCT i.supplier_product_id) product_count, SUM(i.base_received_qty) total_base_qty,SUM(i.supply_amount) total_supply_amount, SUM(i.supply_amount)/NULLIF(SUM(i.base_received_qty),0) weighted_unit_cost, MIN(CASE WHEN i.received_qty>0 AND i.base_received_qty>0 THEN i.supply_amount/i.base_received_qty END) min_unit_cost, MAX(CASE WHEN i.received_qty>0 AND i.base_received_qty>0 THEN i.supply_amount/i.base_received_qty END) max_unit_cost, DATE_FORMAT(MIN(r.receipt_date),'%Y-%m-%d') first_receipt_date,DATE_FORMAT(MAX(r.receipt_date),'%Y-%m-%d') last_receipt_date FROM tb_goods_receipt_item i JOIN tb_goods_receipt r ON r.goods_receipt_id=i.goods_receipt_id JOIN tb_supplier s ON s.supplier_id=r.supplier_id LEFT JOIN tb_account_ingredient_master ai ON ai.account_id=r.account_id AND ai.ingredient_id=i.ingredient_id WHERE r.account_id=#{account_id} AND i.ingredient_id IS NOT NULL AND i.ingredient_id=#{ingredient_id} GROUP BY i.ingredient_id,i.base_unit ORDER BY total_supply_amount DESC,i.ingredient_id

SELECT i.goods_receipt_item_id,DATE_FORMAT(r.receipt_date,'%Y-%m-%d') receipt_date,r.status receipt_status, s.supplier_code,s.supplier_name,p.supplier_product_id,p.supplier_item_code,p.product_name, i.received_qty,i.order_unit,i.unit_price,i.supply_amount,i.vat_amount,i.total_amount,i.base_received_qty,i.base_unit, CASE WHEN i.received_qty>0 AND i.base_received_qty>0 THEN i.supply_amount/i.base_received_qty END unit_cost FROM tb_goods_receipt_item i JOIN tb_goods_receipt r ON r.goods_receipt_id=i.goods_receipt_id JOIN tb_supplier s ON s.supplier_id=r.supplier_id JOIN tb_supplier_ingredient_product p ON p.supplier_product_id=i.supplier_product_id WHERE r.account_id=#{account_id} AND i.ingredient_id=#{ingredient_id} ORDER BY r.receipt_date DESC,i.goods_receipt_item_id DESC
